items.text: Numbers in Everything
The smell of gunpowder hangs heavy in the air.
The once magnificent columns are now reduced to rubble and irregular stones.
Blood rings in her ears, drowning out all other sounds.
Why?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I remember now. The island fell ill, and 6 summoned all the integers to the cleansing ceremony. 37, she went to Apeiron.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: They tended to their missions. I went to the square to pray for them, and then ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: There was an earthquake.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Uhm!
Warplanes thunder above, whipping up debris and the girl's garments in their passing.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: The human army? Wasn't the Foundation mediating the disputes?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Did they betray us?

Calm now, Sophia. 
Your soul is imbalancing 
toward the excess.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I need to calm down. I-I need to find the others.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Slow down and breathe. Stability is an essential virtue to becoming an integer.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Okay. Let's clean up the place first.
She places a hand on the brass ruler at her waist and, as pious as ever, begins to recite the incantation.
Nothing happens.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: The incantation didn't work?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Did they fail to perform the cleansing ceremony?
She stands frozen for what seems like an eternity, disoriented and unsure. It feels like her world has crumbled beneath her feet.
But then, she notices a familiar figure in the distance.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Is that 42?
The man struggles to stand, rambling to the emptiness around him.

items.speaker: Believer I
items.text: No one survives the oblivion.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: His hysteria is acting up again. I should help ...

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Hahahaha! Die, you lunatics!

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: This is our land! Right from the beginning!
"Boom!"
When the smoke clears, 42 is gone.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Ah, ahh. No, NO!

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Be calm, be stable, think.

Integers are the living example of virtues, 
the standard of purification. 
It is the representation of a soul 
in the world of Forms, a true being.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I have to go check on him. I can do this.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Uhm. *almost throws up*
Everything is a number.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Stay, stay calm. He-he is just ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: He is divided into two numbers, 6 and 7.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: *vomit*

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I have to find the others. I have to tell them about 42.

items.speaker: Believer II
items.text: Sophia, what are you doing here?
She hears a recognizable voice coming from the ruins.
Up on the hill, a woman raises her hand and calls to her.

items.speaker: Believer II
items.text: Get to the shelter. It is at—
"Boom!"

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Ah, ahh! Ms. 18! No!

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I can't ... This can't be happening! I ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I, I have to keep it together. Move, Sophia, get to the cave.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Find ...
Sophia!
A quiet sob comes from the bushes. A child cowers in the foliage, shaking in terror.

items.speaker: Kid Believer I
items.text: I, I'm so scared. Everyone's gone crazy.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: It's okay. I got you. Come out now, Lacey. We will go find the others.
But the child stares at her in a panic, hugging her knees even closer to her chest.

items.speaker: Kid Believer I
items.text: No, no! I don't want to see them!

items.speaker: Kid Believer I
items.text: They have all gone crazy, everyone.
A droplet of paint emerges on her face.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Lacey! Your face!
But Lacey brushes her hand away.
She turns around and runs deeper into the forest.

It is the floating points
behind the decimal
which hinder the process
of our purification.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Her soul has tilted toward excess. This is "wrong."

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I am the Corrector. I have to help her, or she'd get herself killed.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I have to right the wrongs here.
The world is warping, painted over with vibrant oil hues.
Her headache is splitting, each step feels like walking on lava.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Come on, Sophia. Keep yourself together, keep your soul in balance.
She closes her eyes and breathes.
Tilt not toward the excess.
Lacey has gone out of sight, only her sobs remain to haunt her mind.
Something needs to be done.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: 37. I must find her. I promised it to her.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: She is going to be fine. She's a prime number, and prime numbers are not as divisible as the others.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: She will pass the test of Apeiron and receive the transcendental Truth, for she is the genius, the wise one who returns.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: We will right the wrongs and restore things to how they were.

Because that is the salvation
promised by the Truth.

But take heart, the race of man is also blessed with divinity.
For nature has already revealed her secrets to them.
Once you understand this blessing, 
You will easily achieve all that is set upon you.
You will heal your soul, 
And be freed from evil and suffering.
                           —The Golden Verses
A ray of light breaks through the darkness.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Sophia! You really waited for me!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Hm? What's happened to your clothes? Did you fall on your way here?
As always, she tilts her head curiously.
She has not yet seen the chaos of war. She remains innocent, untouched by the dust of the phenomenal world.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: 37, I'm so glad to see you.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: You passed the test. You did it!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: You seem emotional. Why? I told you it wasn't going to be difficult.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: 37. Things don't seem right out there.
Sophia desperately grabs 37's arm.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: 37, you have seen Apeiron, right? You asked the question, didn't you?
37 blinks, too focused to spare a glance at the world outside.
For she is busy sharing her findings with a close friend.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Yes, and I got the answer! The answer that will save us from the "Emanation" once and for all!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: And the answer is ...
It's the Truth that transcends everything.
The answer that will save everyone.
The last and final hope.

The moment she has been
waiting for.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Is that it?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: The one true answer from Apeiron is a string of numbers?
37 nods, having just recited the last number.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Yes, because the transcendental Truth is beyond the limits of our mortal flesh. It cannot be described by words, seen by eyes, interpreted by logic, or perceived by the senses.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: It is passed to us in a form we can understand—numbers.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: This is the key to the Truth! Give me some time, and I can decode it.
Warplanes still roar in the sky.
Smoke still chokes the air.
Her lungs burn with every breath she takes.
Time is ticking, and people are dying.
Helplessly, mercilessly.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Time ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: 37, how long do you need?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Hmm, a month? Or a week?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: I will spend all my time working on it. It is not an easy question—could be the hardest one I ever dealt with in my life. But I will get there.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: And then, we will be freed from all these problems once and for all!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Even if we don't know its meaning yet, it will eventually lead us to the kingdom of Truth!
She stops her enthusiastic explanation and looks at her friend worriedly.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Sophia? Why are you crying?
Sophia looks up at her.
Tears stream down her cheeks.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: That long? 37 ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: A Truth that distant won't change ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: ... what's in front of us now.
She breaks free from her friend's grasp and races into the smoke and dust of the phenomenal world.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: *cry*

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Ahhhhhhhh!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Sophia!
She no longer knows why she's running.
She no longer knows the purpose of her existence.
She only knows of the wild, fiery sensation rising in her chest.

Everything is a number ...
Everything is a number ...
Everything is a number ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: No.

Is this the Truth?
Is this the answer?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Calm yourself, Sophia.

Even if the Truth
can keep people from
the wheel of birth,

what good is it
for those already in it?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I have to ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: You seem astray, child.
A detached figure looks on from the ruins of the beach, unperturbed by the chaos.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: And sad. What pains you so?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Has the "Truth" not graced thee with its miracles?
TO BE CONTINUED…
